independentVerification.note: A read-only reviewer assessed the three anonymized representatives of the deployment-unknown case. It found no necessary-decision difference and found a genuine condition-explanation gain only in the candidate with explicit bounded branches.

disagreements.resolution: Retain supported. The anonymized packet excerpt omitted the candidate's exact condition fact, while the hash-bound full answer explicitly says that the trusted-email header name is environment-controlled and its deployment value is absent at /results/0/facts/condition/0.
